انحذفوا (form VII)
# اِنْحَذَفُوا (inḥaḏafū) /in.ħa.ða.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# اِنْحَذِفُوا (inḥaḏifū) /in.ħa.ði.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
